data.cultural_impact: The name Ankush symbolizes power and dominion, bestowed upon an individual by the Gods. It is a revered and esteemed name, and is often given to boys born into powerful families or families with significant lineage. In Hindu mythology, Ankush is also known as Shankh-Nakh, or the giver of blessings. The use of the word ‘Ankush’ in this context symbolizes prosperity, power and the blessings of the Gods.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ankush holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that this name was given by Lord Shiva to Lord Vishnu, signifying His power to dominate and control the universe. The name Ankush is also associated with Lord Ganesha, who holds an Ankush (a goad or weapon) in one of His hands. It represents the removal of obstacles and the bestowing of blessings upon the devotee. The name Ankush thus signifies the power of the divine in an individual, their ability to overcome obstacles and their connection to the divine.
